title: The Frozen Mountain
opening: A grumpy blizzard froze Crystal Mountain, and the mountain crystals went dark! Climb from the bottom to the very top and warm each spot with your fairy light.
not_yet: Brrr! That spot is still frozen solid. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: At the bottom where tall trees grow, the Pine Grove is buried in snow. Shake the frost off with a wave!
Next, a pool all frozen white. The Hot Springs need your warming light. Make the bubbly water steam!
Up the trail, a bridge of ice! Wave your wand, don't slip, be nice. Melt the Ice Bridge back to wood!
Almost there, the climb is steep! The Crystal Cave is fast asleep. Wake the crystals, pink and blue!
To the very top you go, where the biggest crystal waits in the snow. Light the Summit Peak and save the mountain!

ending: The Summit Crystal blazes bright! The snow melts into flowers, the sun comes up, and the sky dances with northern lights. You are the Mountain Guardian!
